verification_basis: Same provider facts as provider_registry.json (schema_version 1, data_version 6). Only the data structure changed; provider behavior was not re-verified.

rules.notes: OpenAI Responses API. GPT-6 supports reasoning.effort=low|medium|high|xhigh|max. none/minimal are not supported and are silently skipped.
OpenAI Responses API. GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) supports reasoning.effort=none|low|medium|high|xhigh|max.
OpenAI Responses API. Generic GPT-5-family fallback for models not matched by a more specific rule above (GPT-5.6 is handled separately). xhigh/max are not supported by this rule.
OpenAI Responses API. Generic o-series (o1/o3/o4) fallback retained from the source registry; exact model-level support can differ.
AgentRouter /v1/responses for GPT-6 models. Uses Responses API reasoning.effort with low|medium|high|xhigh|max. none/minimal are normalized to low.
AgentRouter Chat Completions for GLM-5 and DeepSeek-V4 models on agentrouter.org. Uses top-level reasoning_effort=low|high|max.

AgentRouter-compatible Chat Completions provider rule for apimaster.ai, true-sota.com and tokenbom.com — a different host set from agentrouter.org above, despite the similar name. Uses top-level reasoning_effort.
DeepSeek V4 official API. Chat Completions uses reasoning_effort=low|high|max; medium and xhigh are normalized to high. Thinking is enabled via extra_body.thinking.type.
Moonshot Kimi K3. Thinking is always enabled; reasoning_effort accepts low|high|max.
Moonshot Kimi K2.6/K2.5 native thinking toggle via extra_body.thinking.type=enabled|disabled. These models do not use reasoning_effort.

Alibaba Cloud DashScope Qwen3.8 reasoning rule. reasoning_effort supports low|medium|xhigh; enable_thinking must be enabled. Official docs also support thinking_budget as an alternative, not represented here.
Alibaba Cloud DashScope generic hybrid-thinking Qwen models. Uses extra_body.enable_thinking as a boolean toggle. Do not assume reasoning_effort except for the explicitly listed Qwen3.8 models above.
Z.AI official GLM-5.3/GLM-5.3-FLASH rule. reasoning_effort accepts only low|high|max; thinking must remain enabled (disabled is rejected).
Z.AI official GLM-5.2 rule. none/minimal stop thinking, low/medium/high are normalized to high, xhigh is normalized to max.
Z.AI official GLM thinking-family toggle for GLM-5.1/5/4.7/4.6/4.5 and GLM-4.5V. reasoning_effort is not assumed for these models.
OpenRouter provider rule. Uses extra_body.reasoning.effort for the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions interface.
Ollama Cloud and Fireworks AI. Both use top-level reasoning_effort=low|medium|high with the same normalization (minimal→low, xhigh→high).
NVIDIA NIM DeepSeek-V4-specific rule. Uses top-level reasoning_effort=none|high|max.
NVIDIA NIM GPT-OSS-specific rule. Uses top-level reasoning_effort=low|medium|high.

Generic NVIDIA NIM thinking-model rule for the listed DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen and Gemma models. Uses extra_body.chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking as a boolean toggle; a universal clear_thinking field is not sent since NVIDIA does not document one.
AIHubMix provider rule. Uses top-level reasoning_effort for its OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions interface.
B.AI (api.b.ai) and TokenBay (api.tokenbay.com). Both use top-level reasoning_effort=low|medium|high with the same normalization (minimal→low, xhigh→high).
Mistral official adjustable reasoning, currently documented only for mistral-small-latest and mistral-medium-3-5. reasoning_effort=high or none.
ModelScope hosted inference. Uses top-level reasoning_effort for supported Qwen3.x and other thinking models.
FreeModel/AI Router. Experimental OpenAI-style reasoning configuration for GPT-5 models on these endpoints.
TokenLayer. Experimental OpenAI-style reasoning configuration for supported GPT-5 models.

Hugging Face endpoint-specific Qwen3.8-27B rule. OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions uses reasoning_effort=low|medium|xhigh. Scoped to this exact endpoint hostname only, not other Hugging Face endpoints.
